outcome: Increased PAS-D staining in decidual cells
Apoptotic appearance of trophoblastic cell nuclei
Dilation of endoplasmic reticulum in trophoblastic cells
Chromatin condensation in capillary endothelial cells
Corrugation of capillary endothelial cell nucleus
cohort: A total of 12 female Wistar Albino rats were used, comprising 6 control rats and 6 streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats.
finding: Diabetes causes histomorphometric, ultrastructural, and apoptotic changes in rat placenta, including increased placental and fetal weight, along with various cellular and structural alterations.
cross-section timing: Observations and sample collection were performed on the 20th day of pregnancy.
